answer_1.quote: Generating text from structured data is arguably challenging for LLMs, given the specifics of D2T generation...
answer_1.outputs: Generated texts for weather forecasts, sports reports, product descriptions, chart captions, entity descriptions

answer_2.quote: We use two separate evaluation methods: manual annotations from human crowdworkers and a custom automatic metric based on GPT-4.

answer_3.quote: For automatic evaluation, we leverage the fact that LLM-based metrics can be customized for a particular task without the need for training data. In our experiments, we use a metric based on GPT-4...

answer_4.quote: We prepared a custom web interface, where an annotator is instructed to annotate text spans with respective error categories. We hired annotators on the Prolific crowdsourcing platform.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were instructed to identify errors in generated texts based on input data, categorizing them into INCORRECT, NOT_CHECKABLE, MISLEADING, or OTHER.
